assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production game material atlas, exactly 3 equal columns by 2 equal rows, six edge-to-edge square material panels. Wide 3:2 image. No gutters, frames, labels, objects or perspective.
Input image 1: style and color reference only, an existing charming painted anime town. Match its brushwork and warm limestone/teal/slate palette, simplified hand-painted Japanese fantasy film background art rather than photographic textures.
Read order left to right, top to bottom:
1. Warm ivory lime plaster: broad soft gouache brush strokes, a few understated irregular pale stone patches, cream with gentle buttery variations, restrained contrast, seamless edges.
2. Blue slate roof tiles: front-on flat orthographic rows of small overlapping rectangular slate shingles, desaturated blue-grey with soft painted edge highlights, no perspective, consistent tile scale, seamless edges.
3. Pale honey limestone paving: top-down flat orthographic rectangular squared paving blocks in a staggered pattern, varied cream/ochre/buff/soft grey, fine warm joints, no perspective, no grass, seamless edges.
4. Honey oak floorboards: top-down orthographic straight narrow wooden planks in staggered lengths, gentle drawn grain and tiny knots, warm muted tan, no glossy photography, seamless edges.
5. Cool blue-grey town cobblestones: top-down orthographic small rounded rectangular setts in staggered rows, subtle blue green and lavender shaded strokes, low contrast, no big cracks, no moss, seamless edges. This is a walkable street material.
6. Muted terracotta brick: flat front orthographic small warm rose-ochre bricks and ivory mortar, subtle broad brush texture, seamless edges.
All six use the SAME calm hand-painted anime background rendering, soft tactile gouache, directional hints of pale upper-left light but NO cast shadows or gradient across entire panels. Material detail must remain legible at modest game sprite scale. Exact grid. Do not draw a house or a scene. No text, no logo, no watermark.
